facts.title: the best baked spinach
ingredients: 3 pounds (1.3 kg) fresh spinach or 3 10-ounce (283-gram) packages frozen spinach, defrosted
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 cup beef, chicken, or vegetable stock (Julia recommends beef)
3/4 cup (85 grams) grated swiss, gruyère, or comté cheese, divided
facts.author: Deb Perelman
